Citadel, Port Coquitlam: 20 houses and 23 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 9 and 1 sold in the month. It is one of 10 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Port Coquitlam.
Citadel homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Citadel, September 2026. Detached houses: 20 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 45% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 23 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 4% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 23 in June to 20 in September (−13.0%), and it took 23.6% of the city’s 72 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 18 in June to 23 in September (+27.8%), and it took 7.3% of the city’s 151 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Citadel for detached houses in September (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in June (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, August, September (a buyers’ best bet).
Citadel share of Port Coquitlam listings and sales by month

In Citadel, its share of the houses listed in Port Coquitlam went from 13.4% in June to 13.1% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 7.8% to 10.3%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Citadel home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

31 townhomes sold in Citadel with a median price of $910,000 (the middle half sold between $874,000 and $1,076,500), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 98.1% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $463 per square foot, a median year built of 1993 and a median strata fee of $486 a month. 30 houses sold in Citadel with a median price of $1,390,000 (the middle half sold between $1,226,250 and $1,579,250), taking a median of 10 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $472 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 5,412 square feet.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Citadel PQ

items.t: Citadel is an established residential neighbourhood on Port Coquitlam's north side, around Citadel Drive and Mary Hill Road, beside Castle Park on the Pitt River side. The City of Port Coquitlam Official Community Plan uses the name Citadel Heights for this same neighbourhood and describes Riverwood and Citadel Heights as established residential neighbourhoods on the north side. Boundary roads are UNVERIFIED — no City neighbourhood map states boundary roads for Citadel / Citadel Heights.

Nearby areas: Oxford Heights and Glenwood PQ to the west and south, Riverwood to the east, Central Pt Coquitlam to the south, Pitt Meadows across the Pitt River. Coast Meridian Road and the Coast Meridian Overpass connect north Port Coquitlam to Lougheed Highway and the Mary Hill Bypass. Driving commute times: UNVERIFIED.

Transit: TransLink buses serve north Port Coquitlam from Coquitlam Central Station and Port Coquitlam Station, and the West Coast Express stops at Port Coquitlam Station; specific route numbers stopping inside Citadel are UNVERIFIED. There is no SkyTrain in Port Coquitlam — an extension is an exploratory business case only (Mayors' Council Feb 19, 2026 work plan), with no funding, route or dates.

Parks and recreation: Castle Park is beside the Citadel area on the Pitt River side of north Port Coquitlam, and the Traboulay PoCo Trail network crosses the city; Hyde Creek Recreation Centre at 1379 Laurier Avenue is the north-side recreation centre, and the Terry Fox Library is at the Port Coquitlam Community Centre, 2150 Wilson Avenue.

Shopping: no shopping centre or grocery store location inside this sub-area was verified on an official source; the OCP supports an appropriate neighbourhood commercial development in the Citadel area — specific stores UNVERIFIED.
How people search for it: "Citadel," "Citadel Heights," "Citadel Port Coquitlam," "Citadel PoCo." No other official alternate name was confirmed: UNVERIFIED.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Citadel PQ

items.t: Zoning — Port Coquitlam Zoning Bylaw No. 3630: single-detached homes sit under RS1, RS2, RS3 and RS4, with minimum lot widths of at least 15 m (RS1), 12 m (RS2), 30 m (RS3) and 9.5 m (RS4); apartment zones RA1 and RA2 and townhouse zones RTh1, RTh2 and RTh3 exist in the bylaw, but no Citadel apartment buildings were confirmed from an official source. Any parcel's actual zone: per-parcel, UNVERIFIED.
SSMUH — Port Coquitlam, as the City states it: the City permits 3 to 6 small-scale multi-unit housing units on RS-zoned lots without rezoning, depending on lot size, location and transit proximity.

ALR block (carried for completeness — no ALR land was confirmed inside Citadel): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Check a parcel on the ALC maps.

blocks.text: Good to know about Citadel PQ

items.t: Two names, one neighbourhood (Nov 1, 2026). The board calls the sub-area "Citadel" while the City's OCP calls the same ground "Citadel Heights" — searches run under only one name miss documents filed under the other.

The OCP leaves a commercial door open at the top of the neighbourhood (Nov 1, 2026). The Official Community Plan supports an appropriate neighbourhood commercial development in the Citadel area — worth a City conversation for corner or edge lots, and not a verified project: no Citadel commercial or presale project is verified on a City page.

Castle Park is the Pitt River front door (Nov 1, 2026). Castle Park sits beside the Citadel area on the Pitt River side of north Port Coquitlam, and the Traboulay PoCo Trail network crosses the city — the amenity frame for the lots on the river side of the heights.

Detached and attached moved in opposite directions in the same month (Sep 2026). Citadel detached sold 9 of 20 (45%) while attached sold 1 of 23 (4%) — a buyer pricing a Citadel lot off the detached headline is reading a different market from the townhouse shelf beside it. faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Citadel?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 20 houses and 23 condos and townhomes listed in Citadel. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Citadel a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 45% (a sellers’ market); condos and townhomes had 4% (a buyers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Citadel from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 17 houses and 11 condos and townhomes sold in Citadel over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in September with 9 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 5 sold.

faq.q: How big is Citadel compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Citadel held 13.1% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 10.3% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Citadel?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 46.5% of the 43 homes listed in Citadel and condos and townhomes made up 53.5%; of the 10 that sold, houses were 90.0% and condos and townhomes 10.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Citadel than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 23 in June to 20 in September 2026 (−13.0%); condos and townhomes rose from 18 in June to 23 in September 2026 (+27.8%).

faq.q: What did townhomes in Citadel sell for?
faq.a: 31 townhomes sold in Citadel between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $910,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Citadel?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.1% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

Not by assumption either way — Citadel Heights is elevated ground, but a significant portion of Port Coquitlam sits in the Fraser and Pitt River floodplain behind dykes, so floodplain status must be checked for the specific lot: UNVERIFIED at parcel level.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Citadel lot?
faq.a: SD43 catchments are address-based. The one locator run on record for this ground (1265 Citadel Dr) returned Hazel Trembath Elementary, Ecole Citadel Middle and École Riverside Secondary — that result belongs to that address only; run the exact address before promising a school.
